rules: named-port data is never unwrapped by member name
canonical transport wrappers are resolved only at their declared binding boundary
only registered assertion outputs determine results
first violated assertion is terminal and cannot be masked by result selection
literal types, closed options and selector grammar validate before execution
exact approximate tolerances are explicit, nonnegative and alias-consistent
parsers preserve the selected complete data and fail closed
CSV Unicode scalar separators, final empty records and post-quote state are explicit
nonnegative safe-integer indexes
single-quote and backslash bracket-name escapes
wildcards preserve parser-recorded document order
unsupported syntax fails ingestion
absolute child paths with positive safe-integer positions
attributes are own literal names
text extraction traverses ordered mixed content
only nodes produced by the restricted XML parser are selectable
XML 1.0 legal characters, document structure, entities, quotes and comments are checked
escape-aware scanning distinguishes literals from forbidden backreferences
lookaround, named groups, legacy numeric and Unicode property escapes are rejected
group-aware nested unbounded quantification checks
pattern, flags, input bytes and worker time remain bounded
